assembly.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 9.0.2-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
known_differences: each scene is encoded by its engine and then re-encoded once by the assembler, so frames differ from the clips by a small amount (allowed: 8 of 255 on average)
HyperFrames draws backgrounds up to 3 levels darker than specified; Remotion and FFmpeg are within 2
scene clips are h264 intermediates, not lossless

limitations: only the first, middle and last clean frame of each scene are compared with its clip
text and layout inside a scene are verified by the engine that drew it, by pixel comparison and not OCR
audio is not produced in this phase
Each use is compared with its file on three frames of the scene's hold, by correlation and colour difference. This proves the pixels are there, not that the composition is good.
